# Journey Peaks

> Journey Peaks is a comprehensive travel guide platform offering curated destination recommendations, culinary travel experiences, and expert travel planning resources across global regions including Europe, North America, and Asia.

Journey Peaks provides destination guides, travel trends, and expert recommendations for travelers of all types—from luxury seekers to family-friendly explorers. The site covers emerging 2026 travel trends, regional travel warnings, and specialized guides for specific demographics including international travelers from South Korea and UAE residents.

## Featured Travel Guides

- [Top European Travel Destinations for 2026: Best Ranked Spots](https://journeypeaks.com/top-european-travel-destinations-for-2026-best-ranked-spots): 2026 European travel guide covering Algarve, Portugal, and Amalfi Coast.
- [Top 6 Family-Friendly Trips on the East Coast](https://journeypeaks.com/top-6-family-friendly-trips-on-the-east-coast): Family travel guide for East Coast destinations including NYC and Washington DC.
- [Top Destinations to Visit Without a Passport](https://journeypeaks.com/top-destinations-to-visit-without-a-passport): Travel guide for US territories including Puerto Rico and Virgin Islands.
- [Top 13 Travel Destinations for UAE Residents in 2026](https://journeypeaks.com/top-13-travel-destinations-for-uae-residents-in-2026): 2026 travel guide for UAE residents featuring Egypt and global destinations.
